errors.evidence: The task specifies a defined group of people: all individuals who formally held the position of United States secretary of homeland security before April 2019.
errors.description: The agent misunderstood the task by not correctly identifying the group of people to consider.

errors.evidence: For each identified university, determine the city where the university is located.
errors.description: The agent made assumptions about the tool output by not verifying the geographical coordinates of the cities.
The agent failed to format the output correctly by not including all relevant cities.

errors.evidence: Now the task instructs us to consider the cities in which those universities are located (each secretary’s bachelor’s institution).
errors.description: The agent hallucinated information about the task instructions.
